item.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
item.text: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/4 to 3-1/2 percent. The vote was 10 to 2.

item.title: Weekly Petroleum Status Report
item.text: U.S. commercial crude oil inventories decreased by 2.1 million barrels from the previous week to 418.3 million barrels. Total motor gasoline inventories increased by 0.8 million barrels.

item.title: Tropical Storm Advisory 12
item.text: At 500 PM EST the center of the storm was located near latitude 24.1 North. Maximum sustained winds are near 60 mph with higher gusts. A hurricane watch is in effect for the Florida Keys.

item.title: Why markets may rally next year
item.text: Analysts think stocks could go much higher. Some believe a soft landing is likely. It feels like optimism is back.
